retirementReason: Worst score reached only 0.60; four shoulder towers remained dome-capped tapering pylons and correction budget was spent.
constructionRule: Use thick closed tapered 8-sided body/drum volumes and true upper-hemisphere dome shells closed by matching horizontal base disks. Drum top diameter must match or exceed 85% of its dome diameter. Dome volume must read as a cap beginning at the drum collar; full-sphere silhouettes are forbidden.
requiredHierarchy: one broad thick lower cathedral frustum with buttressed shoulder depth
two deeply overlapping broad transept shoulders and one rear apse
two thick faceted central keep/drum stages whose upper width matches the hero hemidome
exactly four thick two-stage satellite shoulders whose drum tops match their hemidome diameter
one closed hero hemidome, four closed subordinate hemidomes, and one small closed crown hemidome
one continuous taper with no pylon, lollipop, separate pillar, or full-sphere roof read
forbidden: narrow tower neck beneath a wide dome
micro-detail used to hide failed massing
